causebase_summary: The organisation’s website identifies itself as the Russian Imperial Order of St Michael the Archangel and describes an Australian Division of a dynastic Order of knighthood “instituted in 1988.” The website presents governance material (a constitution and a 2012 statute), a “Join now” membership prompt, a photo gallery and a contact/enquiry form. The site states that a “Foundation Contribution” is applied to running the Order and to “humanitarian activities,” and that an “Annual Oblation” supports charitable works designated by “Her Imperial Highness” through the Australian Division Office. The website says monies collected by branches will be retained by the branch for operating expenses and local charity support approved by the Grand Council, with 25% of branch collections remitted to the Australian Division Office. The site also includes liturgical text for a moleben used at investiture ceremonies. An ACNC extract and the organisation’s AIS for 2022–23 are recorded in the evidence pack; the AIS extract shows reported revenue and expenses of AUD 0 for 01/07/2022–30/06/2023. The material in the evidence pack is primarily drawn from the organisation’s own website and ACNC filings.
